subject: Keystore integration kickoff / BYOK & HSM acceptance checklist
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Grant <laura.grant@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Security Team <security@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Keystore integration kickoff / BYOK & HSM acceptance checklist

Hi Laura / Acme team —

Thanks for signing the Private deployment agreement. Per our onboarding plan, this thread captures the acceptance criteria we need to close out the BYOK/HSM integration for your VPC deployment. High-level asks below; I attached a draft network diagram and the integration checklist.

Critical items for the first gate (pre-cutover):
- HSM model & firmware: confirmed model, firmware image, and FW signing verification method (we need attestation statement).
- Crossconnect + routing: private peering details, IP ranges, eBGP vs. static, and any transit NATs that may rewrite source IPs for operator flows.
- Certificate chains: where Acme will host the CA and how Redwood will validate device certs (ocsp/ct logs or local CA bundle).
- Key import workflow: BYOK envelope format, wrapped KEK, and operator access controls for import/unwrap.
- Rotation windows: proposed quarterly rotation cadence, preferred maintenance windows, and rollback path if a rotation fails.
- Audit evidence: logs we require for SOC2 evidence (HSM audit logs, KMS op logs, operator session recordings or bastion transcripts).

Action items / next steps:
1) Acme: confirm HSM appliance model + provide hsm_attestation_statement.pdf (see attachment).
2) Redwood (Karthik): produce an updated runbook with the exact API endpoints and minimal privileges for the import operator.
3) Acme: share peering ASN & IP blocks so we can validate crossconnect config (drive link).

I propose a 30-minute acceptance call on Tue 9/21 10:00 PT to walk the checklist and sign off the pre-cutover gate. Please confirm availability.

Thanks,
David

--
David Kim
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Grant <laura.grant@acme-analytics.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Keystore integration kickoff / BYOK & HSM acceptance checklist

David —

Thanks, and happy to kick this off. Quick notes from our side:
- HSM model: Thales Luna XS 8 (fw 5.2.1). I'll attach our attestation PDF to the Atlassian page; for now I uploaded a stub (hsm_attestation_statement.pdf).
- Network: We'll provision a dedicated VIF to the Redwood VPC and advertise 10.40.0.0/20; eBGP is preferred.
- BYOK envelope: Our security team prefers using an RSA-OAEP wrapped KEK with AES-GCM for the key blobs. We can produce the wrapped files via our on-prem KMS.
- Rotation: Acme policy requires operator rotation every 90 days and key rotation at a minimum of 180 days for master KEKs. We can be flexible on the first rotation window if Redwood wants a canary test.

We are available Tue 9/21 10:00 PT. Also looping in our infra-security engineer, Marco (marco@acme-analytics.com), for any routing specifics.

Laura
Head of Cloud Security, Acme Analytics

Date: 2026-09-21T07:58:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Keystore integration kickoff / BYOK & HSM acceptance checklist

Putting together the runbook increments requested. Draft summary of changes I will push to the shared drive before the call:
- Import operator role: least-priv privilege policy (ImportOnly, No-unseal, No-unwrap-except-with-kev) and the exact CLI/API calls (redwoodctl keystore import --wrap-algo rsa-oaep --nonce).
- Attestation check: we will require HSM-provided signed attestation + SHA256 of firmware image. We will validate attestation signature against the vendor's root certificate bundle; if vendor root not available, we accept an offline CA-signed attestation.
- Network validation: test matrix for RTT and packet path for operator sessions (bastion -> HSM management interface over dedicated crossconnect). Include a TLS mutual-auth handshake test.
- Audit ingestion: Redwood will ingest HSM audit events via streaming syslog over an encrypted tunnel; events will be indexed and retained per the contract (90 days default; extendable).

I also added an emergency rollback section: if an import/rotation fails, operators must mark the key as 'quarantine' and escalate to Redwood on-call; we will provide a one-hour rollback SLA for critical production keys during the initial 30-day cutover period.

Attachments pushed: runbook_draft.md, minimal API examples, and a short template for the import envelope. I'll be ready to walk through the import CLI examples on the call.

- Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Grant <laura.grant@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Keystore integration kickoff / BYOK & HSM acceptance checklist

Thanks everyone — good call today. Quick summary and acceptance notes: 

What Acme agreed to deliver by 9/24:
- Provide the exact firmware SHA256 and signed attestation (hsm_attestation_statement.pdf uploaded).
- Share BGP session config (ASNs, neighbor IPs) and a test VIF provision date.
- Produce two wrapped KEK blobs (canary + prod) with corresponding import manifests.

Redwood acceptance items we committed to by 9/25:
- Validate the attestation and signoff on the HSM model/firmware.
- Run mutual-auth TLS test and confirm operator session path works with the designated crossconnect.
- Execute a canary import during a 30-minute maintenance window; if the canary succeeds, schedule main import the following maintenance window with 1-hour rollback SLA.

Open questions (tracking in the drive):
- Does Acme want Redwood to hold a wrapped escrow copy for emergency recovery? If yes, we need written approval from Acme Security with the escrow key custody agreement signed.
- Logging retention: default 90 days — do you require longer retention for audit?

I'll convert this summary into an action-tracking checklist in the shared drive and loop in Kimberly to coordinate the commercial sign-off if escrow or longer retention is requested.

Monica
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
